basis: 20 answerable dev questions and 2 insufficient-evidence dev questions; Day 6 former test questions are dev only
criterion: Among the three agent configurations, maximize manually reviewed fully grounded answers on 20 answerable dev cases, counting model errors as not successful; then fewer errors, then lower retrieval time. Both insufficient-evidence cases must abstain.
limitations: Selection uses small dev set and non-independent review. H08 is ambiguous. Errors were not retried. Retrieval-only configuration improvements were evaluated but not independently agent-tested.
